high_level_description: This image is a split-screen photograph showcasing two different views of St. Mary's Basilica in Bangalore. Left Side: The left side of the image captures the exterior of St. Mary's Basilica at night. The basilica is illuminated with blue lighting, highlighting its architectural details. A large cross is prominently displayed at the top of the central tower. The surrounding area appears dark, suggesting it is nighttime. There are some silhouettes of people visible near the base of the church, possibly visitors or worshippers.
